tasks.brief: A four-line pre-match trash-talk exchange between Barry and Peaux, spoken in the trailer park just before the bell. Candidate flavour text for the moment before the versus text; it is not wired into the game.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Pick up them cigarette butts, boy, or I'll plant you in this Duckville gravel.

lines.speaker: peaux
lines.text: Make me, redneck. Eyeliner's tougher than eye black, and my brothers hit harder than you.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Twenty years of trucking and a Hoon dirt track. I'll Irish Whip you into your trailer.

lines.speaker: peaux
lines.text: Expelled at sixteen, old man. Stomping a trucker's gut is the only homework I finish.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Pick up your cigarette butts, boy, or I'll plant you in this gravel like a tomato.

lines.speaker: peaux
lines.text: Those are my brothers' butts. They hit harder than you, and they're nicer about it.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Nice mustache don't pay for the gut, huh? Well, this gut's gonna Irish Whip you.

lines.speaker: peaux
lines.text: Cute. Try it, old man. I've been thrown off better trailers than yours.
